THE OPPONENT'S DEITY-WORD IS REFUSED EVERY TIME [claim G53-30]. The household images are rendered IMAGES, and where their owner says 'my gods' the translation gives MY OBJECT OF FEAR. A contempt policy applied consistently, repeated at the echo verse rather than chosen once. [folded shape: dual-track translation]

THE ACT GENERATES A TAUNT TWO SPANS LATER, AND THE ANSWER IS KEPT TOO [claim G53-29]. When a cup is found in the youngest brother's sack the taunt is thief, son of a thief - reaching back to this verse - and his retort is preserved with it: is the man who sold Joseph here? The record keeps the counter-accusation, not only the charge. [folded shape: cross-corpus link]

The order of loading is separately read - sons before wives - against the brother's inverse order at his own departure. [folded shape: kept record]
